exposure: Involvement in antenatal cervical cancer screening
outcome: Attitude towards antenatal cervical cancer screening
Perceived feasibility of antenatal cervical cancer screening
Perceived benefits of antenatal cervical cancer screening
Perceived harms of antenatal cervical cancer screening
cohort: The study participants were Dutch midwives, gynecologists, and general practitioners.
finding: A majority of Dutch midwives, gynecologists, and GPs considered the introduction of antenatal cervical cancer screening feasible, believing it could improve motivation to attend and reduce test-related barriers.
